
### backbone  {.smaller}


* OSPF area 0 is called ‘‘backbone’’
* border routers only summarize routes sent to backbone <i>or</i> not obtained from other area border routers 
<hr class="vspace" />
* means routing between areas must either: 

   * go through the backbone, or
   * only go through one border router

* makes loops not possible


### backbone limits 

::: {.r-stack .my-full}
![](/routing-ls/texfig/ospf-backbone-limits.figure-1.svg){.fragment .fade-out fragment-index=3 fig-alt="network with backbone, site A, and site B. site A and site B are connected to each other via a router; site A is connected to the backbone via another router; site B is also connecte to the backbone via a third router."}

![](/routing-ls/texfig/ospf-backbone-limits.figure-3.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=3 fig-alt="the link from site B to its backbone-connected router goes down"}

![](/routing-ls/texfig/ospf-backbone-limits.figure-4.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=4 fig-alt="the router between site A and B has two 'virtual' connections: one to the router attaching site A to the backbone, the other to the router attaching site B to the backbone."}

:::

::: {.myoverbox .fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=2 .midright}

*  organization with two sites
*  can configure as areas
*  three border routers

:::

::: {.myoverbox .fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=3 .midright}

*  if B's link to backbone fails</br>
   B should use site A's
*  _disallowed_ by anti-loop rule!

:::

::: {.myoverbox .fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=4 .midright}

*  could fix this by connecting<br/>
   A/B border router to backbone
*  solution: "virtual links"

:::


### OSPF virtual links  {.smaller}


* ‘‘tunnel’’ backbone through another area 

   * route as if ‘direct’ connection between two border routers
   * but connection implemented by going through area
   * both ends considered part of backbone

* metric for virtaul link = metric of route through area 
<hr class="vspace" />
* configured explicitly by administrator
